# C04 dialogue API

All values are inert until J provides authenticated native adapters. No DTO, JSON field, correlation UUID, digest or test lambda grants authority. A owns root WAITING_FOR_PLAYER, continuation, budgets, cancellation and goal policy.

- DialogueSnapshot.initial receives the validated C02 AssistanceRequest and server-bound player/session audience. The exact ActivityRef, question UUID, dialogue revision, response generation, replay ledgers, expiry, backoff and pending correlations remain bounded. Its own cc.c.dialogue.snapshot/1 envelope is separate from the frozen interaction contract. encode/restore perform no IO. Restore always locks the snapshot, regardless of serialized claims.
- AssistanceDialogue returns a new snapshot plus at most one typed proposal. begin -> ASKED -> validated model delivery acknowledgement -> AWAITING_REPLY. A matching CHECK_AGAIN -> REOBSERVE_REQUESTED with one ActivityResumeSignal request_kind REVALIDATE_ONLY. Native C02 reobservation can update the remaining shortage on the same question, or enter WAITING_OWNER_DECISION when feasible. It never grants effect or settlement credit.
- NativeGate is a read-only J port for authenticated PLAYER, PRESENTER and OWNER context. Player/session/world/domain/principal/citizen, exact activity, question/revision and response generation must match; a forged new root is refused, while an authentic native owner/root/generation change closes the old question without rebasing it. Unavailable authority refuses work.
- Unchanged/wrong-item shortage uses the actual B result. Backoff is 2/4/8 seconds capped at original expiry. After three identical observations, only a relevant authenticated native world change permits another explicit check. At most eight accepted reply rounds and sixteen delivered message IDs are retained. Duplicate replies, duplicate delivery receipts and late model results cannot repeat proposals. Clock rollback refuses transitions; exact expiry closes the question.
- HELP requests phrasing only. CHOOSE_TARGET carries an untrusted endpoint selector to A. CANCEL proposes cancellation and waits for A acknowledgement; C cannot cancel a Job. CORRECT_GOAL enters CLARIFICATION; a separate bound explicit player confirmation is required before an untrusted amendment proposal reaches A. A decides whether to amend or create a separate root; C never mutates the original goal or ActivityRef.
- revalidateRestored requires A's native root/question/revision/audience/replay-journal check and the exact snapshot digest. A changed current root closes the old dialogue. Successful revalidation fences old responses and emits neither a prompt replay nor a resume request. Native terminal state remains terminal.

DialogueTransition exposes only PreparePrompt, DeliverPrompt, Reobserve and OwnerDecision proposals. DeliverPrompt still requires C03's validated grounded text and J's authenticated transport. Proposal consumers must not equate a proposal with an accepted owner decision or a world effect. No production composition root is changed.

blobs.a4b92d8ae077b4ac022cf6520b2827f2eec692c4:
# C01 candidate API and bounded context

`IntentParser.parse(Transport, ConversationContext, monotonicMillis)` returns a validated but untrusted Candidate or typed Clarify. It has no world/effect dependency. `infer` explicitly selects one extractor, makes one primary request and at most one correction to that same extractor. Provider exceptions and correlation failures terminate immediately. There is no provider list or implicit fallback. C06 owns the real provider adapter; C01 test extractors provide synthetic control coverage only.

`CandidateValidator.validate(Draft, Transport)` checks the frozen strict codec, exact transport/session/message/text correlation, source spans and the complete supported grammar. The separate Draft evidence wrapper does not alter cc.cd/1.0.0. Candidate construction is private to the validator. Every returned wire message remains an InteractionWire.UntrustedMessage. Nothing constructs TrustedProjection, ActivityRef, a world capability, grant or settlement.

## Supported explicit grammar

Optional leading `please `, surrounding whitespace and a final `.`, `!` or `?` are accepted. Action keywords are case insensitive; quoted NFC labels and item text retain exact case and characters. Quoted labels cannot contain quotes or backslash escapes in C01. Unsupported or compound commands clarify; they do not become action candidates or inferred defaults. C07 owns subsequent language expansion.

| Candidate | Example | Route |
|---|---|---|
| CHAT | `Hello Ada` | Ordinary chat, no ActivityRef or consent |
| FORGET | `forget this conversation` | Clear only this session's ephemeral text |
| COME | `come here` or `come to me` | Resolve; J captures server position |
| FOLLOW | `follow me` | Resolve; J binds current player |
| STOP | `stop` | Resolve current authorized activity at J |
| STATUS | `status` | Resolve authorized status at J |
| GO_NAMED | `go to chest "Pantry"` | Resolve exact permitted storage |
| DELIVER | `deliver 3 bread from chest "Pantry" to citizen "Bob"` | Resolve quantity, item and both endpoints |
| REGISTER_STORAGE | `register this chest as "Pantry" for food` | Explicit server confirmation required |
| RENAME_STORAGE | `rename chest "Pantry" to "Kitchen"` | Explicit server confirmation required |
| ASSIGN_STORAGE | `assign chest "Kitchen" as food storage` | Resolve beneficiary control and ASSIGN at J |
| SET_STORAGE_ACCESS | `set chest "Kitchen" access to public deposit` | Explicit server confirmation required |
| CHECK_AGAIN | `check again` | Correlated reply requesting revalidation only |
| CHOOSE_TARGET | `choose barrel "Food"` | Correlated reply with candidate selector |
| CORRECT_GOAL | `correct goal: use wheat instead` | Confirmation-required proposal |
| CANCEL | `cancel` | Correlated reply; A acknowledgement required |
| HELP | `help` | Correlated reply about the same question |

Endpoint forms are `chest/barrel/storage "Label"`, `citizen "Label"`, `this/selected chest/barrel/storage`, `your default/food/materials/output chest/barrel/storage`, `nearest public chest/barrel/storage`, and `you` as the addressed citizen. A storage selector always carries CHEST, BARREL or ANY_MVP. Selected forms require the matching server-supplied selection token/type. Nearest is available only when explicitly requested. All labels, role assignments and public-access requests remain untrusted proposals; names never grant control. Actual ambiguity, visibility and permissions require J/D resolution.

Access forms are `private`, `public deposit`, `public inspect deposit`, and `public inspect deposit withdraw`. Quantities are exact decimal integers in 1..64, parsed without rounding or truncation. Omitted endpoints or quantities clarify. Source citizen/carrier identity, native selection reach/topology, installed item components and operation-specific permission checks remain J requirements before effects.

## Correlation and source evidence

Transport keys use stable world/principal/addressed-citizen UUIDs supplied by authenticated server ingress. They are not extracted from names or text. The message UUID and monotonically increasing sequence belong to that transport session. A replayed sequence or retained message ID refuses another inference attempt. J must allocate these values, enforce transport authenticity across logout/expiry, and revalidate authority before any action.

Draft spans use UTF-16 half-open offsets into the exact original text; offsets splitting surrogate pairs refuse. Text-origin fields require the complete expected span set. The validator independently grounds the full candidate against the finite grammar, including negation/compound rejection, so a substring or copied label cannot supply an action, different actor, quantity or access grant. There is no model-to-world route.

A PlayerReplyIntent must match the exact current server-displayed question UUID and revision supplied in Transport. A matching string, candidate schema or correlation header is not A authorization or proof. Old/cross-principal responses refuse. CORRECT_GOAL is still only text proposing a change; CHECK_AGAIN cannot resume an activity.

## Ephemeral limits

| Limit | Bound |
|---|---:|
| Retained turns per stable session key | 8 |
| Characters per utterance | 1024 Unicode code points |
| Retained text per session | 4096 Unicode code points |
| Idle text lifetime | 600000 monotonic milliseconds |
| Live sessions in one server-scoped store | 128 |
| Candidate output | 16384 UTF-8 bytes |
| Extractor requests per accepted message | One primary plus at most one correction |

The oldest complete text turns are removed to meet retention bounds; oversized or malformed utterances refuse without truncation/normalization. Snapshots are immutable. Reads and refused replays do not renew idle time. At the exact idle boundary text is cleared. An active opaque assistance pin is retained until the server explicitly clears it; capacity refuses new sessions instead of evicting such a pin. There are at most 128 pins/sessions. C owns no durable activity state.

FORGET clears caller/citizen text while preserving the live replay fence and opaque pin. Logout clears C memory for that world/principal across citizens, without cancelling or erasing A state. A late extractor result cannot erase a newer message. The eventual J adapter must use one shared ConversationContext per server and supply a monotonic clock; clock rollback refuses.

## Qualification scope

The [C01 report](C01.md) records actual results separately. Unit/Python checks are synthetic contracts, not Minecraft gameplay, connected-client evidence or genuine model compatibility. The existing frozen module baseline, C00 codec cases, fixture compilation, contract parity and ownership/packaging audits remain cumulative gates.

# C03 response API and limits

All classes remain inert until J integration. C03 has no Job writer, effect, inventory, dispatch or trusted-terminal API.

- `ResponseFacts.forBlocker(C02 Projection, locale)` copies only redacted language facts: mode, English language key and authorized item registry IDs/missing quantities. Roots, storage names, coordinates, actors and chat are absent. `smallTalk(locale)` carries no world/history claims. A language packet grants no authority; J must authenticate scope and revalidate disclosure at delivery.
- `ResponseTemplates.choices/fallback` supplies finite short English phrasings for every blocker and bounded small talk. Long material lists use a generic authorized-list explanation. Unsupported locales fall back to English without retaining their input.
- `ResponseValidator.validate(facts, json)` requires exactly text and matching facts_sha256. Only a complete approved phrasing is accepted. Duplicate/unknown fields, invented counts/names/status, commands and history fail closed. Output text is at most 256 ASCII bytes; this does not claim arbitrary natural language can be verified.
- `ConversationProvider` uses the unchanged LlmProvider SPI. Ticket carries server-supplied world/principal/citizen/session/generation/sequence/message correlation. A currentness predicate fences callbacks and delivery. No Generation.ValidatedRequest or research-role substitution occurs.
- Online admission requires a TokenBudget with pinned model/tokenizer digests and actual serialized-prompt tokenization. Byte length is only an input-size guard, never a tokenizer. Each of at most two attempts reserves its measured input up to 1024 and output up to 128 tokens, for cumulative maxima 2048/256. Both share one 10-second deadline. Generic SPI actual usage remains unknown.
- At most two operations are outstanding globally across wrapper instances; one response per principal/citizen pair is admitted per two seconds. Pair metadata is capped at 128 with ten-minute idle expiry and no global raw-chat log. Timeout/cancellation does not prove remote compute termination: its slot remains held until pending work settles. Two hung providers therefore make later online calls fall back.
- J supplies the existing timer owner. The production constructor invokes provider/tokenizer work asynchronously. The advanced deterministic test constructor requires an appropriate executor for real IO.

## Genuine provider qualification and C04 recovery

The Actions host reuses a healthy pinned service or automatically starts the pinned CI model Docker container when the configured backend is unavailable. live_provider.py measures actual generation/tokenization on that selected service; ci_backend.py owns download/build/readiness/cleanup. The immutable GGUF, server commit/build, image/binary identities and tokenizer/template digest are verified and retained. See [CI strategy](ci-strategy.md) and [C04 evidence](C04.md).

Response schemas constrain text to the exact approved phrase enum and facts_sha256 to the packet digest. The pinned llama.cpp parser accepts response_format type json_object with schema directly; its json_schema type requires a nested wrapper. The live adapter uses the supported direct form, verifies it independently and retains explicit null unknown-SPI-usage fields alongside actual native HTTP usage.

Optional COGNITIVECRAFT_C_MODEL_{URL,ALIAS,SHA256,FILE,SERVER_PATH,BUILD} repository variables select an existing service. FILE must be a checksum-verified GGUF under build/e2e-sdk/models or build/parallel-c-cache/models. Malformed/credential-bearing URLs and arbitrary host files are not forwarded. Missing or unhealthy service configuration activates the pinned CI Docker fallback. Unexpected bootstrap failure retains raw logs and remains blocked; synthetic success is never substituted.

The six actual-model fixtures use synthetic facts and provide no native/client/A-root credit. Final C04 executed six generation calls and accepted all six responses without fallback. C03's earlier zero-execution historical handoff is retained unchanged and remains unqualified. Offline fallback is tested independently of online availability.
